talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_cybor: Now there's a proper cyborg. Haven't seen one in a long while.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: A cyborg, walking about in the open. Who did the work on you? I'd like to see their joins.
Frostborn hands, mostly.
It shows. Clean work. Not many left who can do it.
What's a cyborg?
You are. More made than born. There's an older word, but nobody here would know it.
Stop staring at my joins.
Hard not to. Fine, fine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_kin: Hail's own, head to heel. Who fitted you? I'd know their hand.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: Head to heel in our people's work. Somebody back home thought a great deal of you.
My kin made sure of it.
Then they did right by you. Keep it oiled, the cold here is the wrong kind.
Some of it I earned.
The best of it always is.
It's only gear.
Only gear. Listen to you. Your grandmother would weep.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_frost: That's our work. All of it. Who sold it to you, or who did you take it off?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: That's Frostborn work on you, more of it than I've seen on anyone not of our blood. How did you come by it?
A Frostborn friend fitted me.
Then you've a better friend than most. They don't fit strangers.
Bought it, piece by piece.
And paid well over the odds, I'd bet. Still, you got the real thing.
That's my business.
It's ours, actually. But keep your secrets.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_warri: Frostborn steel on a ground-dweller. They taught us the stars, you know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: All that Frostborn work, on one of you. My people learned the dark between worlds from theirs. Did you know that?
I didn't. Tell me more.
Not much to tell. They crossed it first. We just crossed it angrier.
I've heard it said.
Then you've heard right. Wear it well.
Keep away from me.
Everyone says that. Few mean it as much as you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_timid: Gods keep us. What are you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: Is there any of you left that's flesh? I'm sorry, I don't mean to stare. I just... what happened to you?
I'm still me under it. Honest.
Right. Of course. Sorry. It's just a lot of metal, that's all.
Frostborn work. It's safe.
If you say so. I'll stand over here all the same.
Boo.
Don't! Don't do that!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_greed: What did all that cost you? An arm? Ha. Well, two.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: That much Frostborn work, on one body. You could buy a farm with what you're wearing. Ever think of selling a piece?
Maybe one day.
When that day comes, you come to me first. I'll be fair. Fairish.
Not for sale.
Everything's for sale. You just haven't heard the right price.
Don't look at me like that.
Like what? Like a fortune on legs? Sorry.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_devou: The gods made you whole once. Who made the rest?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: The gods made each of us whole, they say. Somebody's made a good deal of you since. Does it trouble you?
The gods let it happen. That's enough for me.
A good answer. I'll pray for the parts of you that are still yours.
Sometimes.
That's honest. Come by the shrine if it ever weighs on you.
Leave the gods out of it.
They're never out of it. But I'll not press you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made: Is there any of you left that's flesh?!
You're more Frostborn work than flesh! Where does a body even get all that?
Friends like that, I'd like to have.
...Right. I'll not ask where his arms went.
Fair. Only it's hard not to look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.rig_frost: A trooper's rig, on you? Where's the trooper?
That's a rig. Our people's war gear. It doesn't usually walk about on someone else.
I found it in a wreck and mended it.
Then whoever wore it isn't wanting it back. Treat it well.
I built it at a forge.
From our designs, I'd bet. Well. At least someone's using them.
Clearly. Mind it doesn't decide otherwise.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.rig_timid: Oh! Oh, it's a person in there.
I thought you were one of those metal things that fall out of the sky. You're not going to... do anything, are you?
Good. Lovely. Pass through, then. Mind the hens.
I'm not doing anything! I'm just standing here!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.rig: Is that a whole suit of Frostborn work?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.open: That's a whole suit of Frostborn work you're walking about in. Is it heavy? Is it warm? Can you hear me in there?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.a.said: Ha! Well, good. I'll not shout, then.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.b.said: Everything is, compared to what it looks.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.c: I'd rather not talk about it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.c.said: Fair enough. It's a fine thing all the same.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.stump_smith: There's a smith here can fit you. That's me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump_smit: You're short a limb and nothing in its place. I can forge you iron, or a carpenter can do you wood. Wood's cheaper. Iron lasts.
Come by the forge with the iron and we'll talk. I don't overcharge the maimed.
You do. You'd manage better with something on that stump.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.stump_kind: Oh, you poor thing. Sit down a moment.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump_kind: You've lost a limb and nobody's even fitted you a peg. Can I fetch you anything? Some water, at least?
Here. And if you need a smith, ours is by the well. Tell him I sent you.
If you say so. Still, you're welcome here.
It's not pity. It's manners. Suit yourself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.stump: You're managing with one? You'd want a peg for that, at least.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump.open: Lost one, did you? I'm sorry for it. You'd want something fitted there, wood if nothing else.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump.a.sa: Try the forge, if there's one here. Or a carpenter for wood.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump.b.sa: And you still get about. That's something.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump.c.sa: No. Sorry. I didn't mean to stare.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_woode: Mine's oak and it creaks. Yours moves like it was born on you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: Look at that. Mine's oak and it creaks in the rain, and yours moves like it was born on you. Where do I get one?
From the Frostborn, if they'll have you.
If. They never have me. Still, it's good to know they exist.
It cost me dearly.
I'd believe it. I'd pay it too, if I had it.
You don't.
No. I don't. Thank you for reminding me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_smith: I couldn't forge that in a hundred years. May I look at the joint?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: That's a made limb. Frostborn. I've only seen drawings. Would you let me look at the joint? I won't touch.
Go on, have a look.
Look at that. No pins, no rivets. I'll be thinking about this for a month.
It's fine as it is.
Oh, I know it's fine. That's the trouble. Mine aren't.
Hands off.
I said I wouldn't touch. Fine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_kin: Good work on your arm. Whose hand is it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: That's good work, that limb. Ours, and well kept. Was it fitted back home or here?
Back home.
I thought so. You can always tell. The joins sit flatter.
Here, by one of ours.
Then there's someone near who still remembers how. Good.
Does it matter?
To me it does. Never mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_frost: That limb's Frostborn-made. Who fitted it for you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: That's one of our limbs on you. We don't hand those out. Who fitted it?
A Frostborn friend.
Then they trust you. That's worth more than the limb.
I bought it fair.
Fair. Hm. I'll take your word for it. This time.
Nobody you'd know.
I know everyone who can fit one of those. But all right.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_greed: That arm's worth more than my house.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: That's Frostborn work, that limb. Worth more than my house and the field behind it. If you ever need coin...
I'll keep that in mind.
Do! I'm always here. Always.
It's attached to me.
Things come unattached. Not that I'd want that. For you.
No.
You didn't let me name a price.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb: Can you feel things with that? Does it get cold?
That arm, or is it a leg? It moves like a real one. Can you feel with it? Does it hurt when it's cold?
Near enough real. Imagine that. My uncle would give his other arm for it.
Mine ache too, and they're my own. You're doing all right.
Sorry. It's only, I've never seen one up close.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter_patrol: Good. Nobody should walk about without one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter_pa: You wear a scouter. Good. Too many out here walk about blind. Keep it on, and keep it charged.
Then you'll see them coming before they see you.
What does it read on you?
More than you'd think. Less than I'd like. Move along.
I am. That's the point of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter_kin: Still wearing your glass, I see. Good.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter_ki: You wear your scouter like one raised to it. Most born here leave theirs in a drawer.
As it should be. Our people don't go about blind.
I'm still getting used to it.
It takes a winter or two. Then you'll feel naked without it.
A tool that sees for you. Mind you don't forget whose it is.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter_wears: Yours is a newer make than mine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter_we: Your scouter. A newer make than mine, if I'm not mistaken. Does it read farther?
I knew it. I'll be saving up again, then.
Good. Then I didn't waste my money.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter_suspici: What's that glass for? Seeing through walls? Through me?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter_su: That glass over your eye. What is it you're reading off me? I've a right to know.
And how strong am I? No, don't tell me. I don't trust it.
That's what someone would say if it was something I'd mind.
I would. That's why I asked.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter: Is that glass for seeing far? Can I have a look through it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter.op: That's Frostborn glass over your eye, isn't it? What does it show you? Could I have a look?
Oh! It's all numbers and colours. How do you read any of it?
Does it? Then don't point it at me. I'd rather not know.
No. No, I suppose not. Still. Lovely thing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended_too: Oak, is it? Mine too. Rain gets in the joint.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended_too: You've a stand-in limb too. Does it ache when the rain's coming? Mine always knows a day before I do.
Ha! Then we're a pair of weathervanes. Good to meet you.
Lucky. Or you've a better carpenter than I had.
Fair. Neither do I, most days.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended_smith: That peg'll split by winter. I could forge you iron, for a price.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended_smi: That wooden limb of yours. It'll split by winter if you lean on it like that. Come to the forge and I'll do you iron.
Bring the iron and we'll talk. I'll go easy on the work.
Until it doesn't. The offer stands.
Suit yourself. Wood's honest, I'll give it that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended_kind: Sit a while, if it pains you. I'll bring a stool.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended_kin: That limb must tire you, walking all day. Sit a while if you like. I'll bring a stool.
There. Rest as long as you need.
Still. The stool's here if you want it.
Of course. I only thought I'd ask.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended_spiteful: Lost it in a fight, did you? Lost the fight too, by the look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended_spi: Wood where a limb should be. Lost a fight, did you? Or just careless?
I lost a fight. The other one lost more.
Ha. I'll believe that when I see him.
Or what? You'll hop at me?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended: A wooden limb? Does it hurt much?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended.ope: You've a stand-in limb there. I hope it doesn't trouble you too much. How did it happen?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended.a: A long story. I'm well enough.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended.a.s: Good. You get about better than most I've seen.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended.b.s: Then I hope the other one looks worse.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.suited_devout: Gods above. What's that on you? It's moving.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_suited_dev: That black stuff on you. It moves when you don't. Whatever it is, it isn't clean. Have you been to a shrine?
Everything says that, at first. I'll pray it stays so.
Then fight it, whatever it is. I'll pray for you.
I will. From a long way off.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.suited_timid: What is that? Stay back! Please stay back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_suited_tim: Please don't come any closer. That black skin of yours, it looked at me. I swear it looked at me.
You don't know that. Nobody could know that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.suited_brave: Whatever's wearing you, it'll not frighten me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_suited_bra: I don't know what that black stuff is, but it'll get no fear out of me. Is there a person under it, or not?
Good. Then you and I can talk like folk. Keep it on a short leash.
Then wonder somewhere else. I've children here.
Try it and see what a pitchfork does to black goo.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_suited.ope: That black stuff all over you. It isn't cloth, is it? It moves on its own. What in the world are you wearing?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_suited.a.s: I'll bet it is. Maybe tell it from over there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_suited.b.s: Harmless things don't ripple like that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_suited.c.s: Touch it? I'd sooner touch a nettle.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.masked_guard: Masks off in town. You know the rule.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_masked_gua: We've had trouble with masked folk. The rule here is plain: you talk to the watch with your face showing, or you don't talk to the watch.
None of you ever do. Keep it that way.
The peace is kept. By us. That's what the watch is for.
Then so do my eyes. On you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.masked_kind: If you're one of the good ones, thank you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_masked_kin: You're one of those masked folk. Some say you're no better than bandits. If you're one of the good ones, thank you.
Then I'll not mind the mask. Stay safe out there.
Good and bad's a matter of who's asking.
Maybe. I'm asking kindly, at least.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.masked_suspicio: What are you hiding under that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_masked_sus: Honest folk show their faces. So what are you hiding? A wanted poster? A family you'd rather not shame?
So you say. A mask lets you say anything.
Everything that walks through my town concerns me.
I'd rather not. I might be right.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.masked_timid: Oh! Please, I haven't got anything.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_masked_tim: Please, I haven't done anything, and I haven't any coin. The last masked one through here broke the cooper's windows.
I'm not here to hurt anyone.
That's what the last one said. Before the windows.
I suppose you couldn't be. He was taller.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.masked_greedy: Is there a price on masked heads these days?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_masked_gre: A masked stranger. I wonder what a lord would pay to see the face under that. Just wondering, you understand.
Not as much as I'd pay you to forget me.
Now you're talking my language. Shall we say a few coins?
No need to be like that. It was only wondering.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.masked_hothead: Go home. We managed before you lot.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_masked_hot: Another one in a mask, playing the hero. We managed fine before you lot came along, and we'll manage after.
Someone does. The watch. Not a stranger in a sack.
It is fair. Now move along.
Go home. We managed before you lot. There, I said it again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.masked: A mask, in broad daylight. One of those, are you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_masked.ope: You're one of those masked folk. Half say you help, half say you're the trouble. Which are you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_masked.a.s: Well. Help quietly, then. Folk here don't like a fuss.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_masked.c.s: Then keep your business out of my street.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.hooded_guard: Hood down when you speak to the watch.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_hooded_gua: Hood down, please. I like to see who I'm talking to.
Thank you. That's all I ask.
And I'd rather you did. Mind yourself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.hooded_suspicio: Hiding from someone, under that hood?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_hooded_sus: That hood. Keeping the rain off, or keeping your face off a wanted poster?
Ha. An honest answer, at least.
I am. You're walking through it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.hooded: Cold out, or hiding from someone?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_hooded.ope: Hood up in the middle of the day. Cold, are you? Or is somebody looking for you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_hooded.a.s: Get yourself by a fire, then. The tavern has one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_hooded.b.s: Then I never saw you. Go on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_hooded.c.s: Not to me. Only folk talk.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.grim_priest: Take that dead thing off before you come near the shrine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_grim_pries: What you've got hanging off you, that's grave-work. A withered thing, a dead hand's charm. Where did you come by it?
Then let it stay killed. Bring it to the shrine and we'll see it burned.
So does breathing. That keeps something else alive too.
Everything's somebody's. Mind whose it was first.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.grim_devout: Gods keep us, what is that hanging on you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_grim_devou: That trinket of yours has a cold look to it. It's not a thing the gods would bless. Does it whisper?
Charms like that have a way of wanting things. Be careful.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.grim_timid: Ugh. Is that... was that someone's?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_grim_timid: That thing you're wearing. It's dead, isn't it? Was it a person once? Please say no.
Oh, thank goodness. Still. Keep it over there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.grim: That's a grim thing to wear about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_grim.open: That's a grim sort of trinket. Most folk would leave something like that where they found it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_grim.a.sai: I'm sure it does. I'd still not wear it to market.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.knight_guard: A knight? Whose are you, then?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_knight_gua: Full plate, and walking like you know how to wear it. Whose knight are you? We like to know who's under the steel in this town.
A hedge knight. Well, behave yourself and there's work for a sword.
A knight who serves himself. That's what the old songs call a bandit.
And the town's my business. Mind it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_knight_gil: Gilded plate, in a place like this. You must be somebody's son, or somebody's very lucky thief.
Then welcome, my lord. We don't get many of you down this road.
Ha! Well. Keep the shine on it.
Knights don't wear gold. Lords do.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.knight_proud: Proper plate. At last someone worth bowing to.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_knight_pro: Now that is proper plate. You don't see a real knight round here, only boys with pots on their heads.
I can tell. It sits right on you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.knight_spiteful: Tin can. Mind you don't rust in the rain.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_knight_spi: All that metal. I suppose you think it makes you better than the rest of us down here in the mud.
No, it doesn't. Glad we agree.
It makes me harder to kill.
We'll see how hard, the day it matters.
Ha. Well, at least you're honest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.knight: A knight, here? Has something happened?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_knight.ope: A knight in full plate, walking through. Is there a war coming, or are you only passing?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_knight.a.s: That's a relief. Mind the cart ruts, you'll sink in that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_knight.b.s: Gods, I hope not. Not again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_knight.c: That's not for you to know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.arms_theirs_gua: Our own arms. Good to see them on someone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_arms_their: You wear %2$s's arms. Sworn, or just fond of the colours? Either way, you're welcome on this watch.
Then we're on the same side. Shout if you need us.
So long as you're fond of the crown that goes with them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.arms_theirs: Our colours! Good to see them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_arms_their: That's %2$s's arms on you. It does a body good to see our colours out on the road.
And proud to see them. Come by any time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.arms_enemy_guar: You've some nerve, wearing those colours here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_arms_enemy: Those are %2$s's arms. We're at war with them, in case nobody told you. Give me one reason not to call the watch.
Then take their colours off. Now.
I took them off a dead one.
Did you. Then you'll not mind taking them off a second time.
That's %2$s on your back. They burned my cousin's farm last spring. What are you doing here wearing that?
Then why dress like it? Take it off before someone else sees.
Sorry doesn't build a barn. Still. Thank you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_arms_other: Those are %2$s's arms, aren't they? Long way from home, or just passing through?
Well, we're friendly here, mostly. Mind the tolls.
Most do. The road's that way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.sky_devout: That's from up there, isn't it? The old sky?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_sky_devout: You wear something that came down from the sky, don't you? The old stones hum like that. Is it blessed, do you think?
Then wear it kindly. The sky gave it for a reason.
Nothing that comes down from up there is only anything.
Nobody does. That's what frightens me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.sky_greedy: Sky-stuff! What'll you take for it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_sky_greedy: That's sky-made, that is. Lighter than it ought to be. I know a buyer would pay through the nose. What'll you take?
That's what they all say, until winter.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.sky: Is that cloud, in a bottle? Or on you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_sky.open: You've something on you that doesn't sit right. Too light, too bright. It came from up in the sky, didn't it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_sky.a.said: I knew it. My grandmother used to say the sky dropped its treasures on the brave.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_sky.b.said: Then the merchant was luckier than he knew.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.fae_kind: Oh! A fairy! Is she happy in there?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fae_kind.o: You've a fairy in a bottle. Is she happy in there? Do you let her out? She looks so small.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fae_kind.a: Good. Look after her. They say a fairy kept well keeps you well.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fae_kind.b: Then she likes you. That's a good sign.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fae_kind.c: Oh. That's a sad thing to say about her.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.fae: Is that a fairy? A real one?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fae.open: That's a fairy in that bottle, isn't it? A real one? I thought they were only in my mother's stories.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fae.b.said: Then I'll stand near you a while.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fae.c.said: Sorry. Sorry, it's just, a fairy!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.holy_priest: You wear the cross. Do you keep the prayers too?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_holy_pries: You wear a holy sign. Plenty do. Fewer keep the prayers that go with it. Do you?
Then the gods will know you. Go well.
Faith isn't luck. But it's a start.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_holy_devou: You wear a holy sign. It does me good to see it out on the road, where folk forget.
Then she's watching over you through it. I'm sure of it.
Nothing worn near the heart is just anything.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.holy_spiteful: A holy sign. Much good it'll do you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_holy_spite: Wearing a holy sign, are you? I wore one too. The gods didn't come when I called.
Maybe. I'll not hold my breath.
Don't be. It's not your doing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_holy.open: You wear a holy sign. Folk here will think the better of you for it, mostly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_holy.a.sai: They will. Unless you give them reason not to.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_holy.b.sai: There's always one who thinks you're putting it on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_holy.c: I don't care what they think.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_holy.c.sai: You will, when you want a bed for the night.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.jewels_greedy: Those stones real? They'd fetch a pretty sum.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_jewels_gre: Those are real stones, aren't they? Rubies? Emeralds? I've an eye for these things. What would you take for one?
Everything is. You just haven't been hungry enough.
Oh, I will. When I've counted my coin. Twice.
I'll keep my eyes where I like.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.jewels_timid: Put those away, there's cutpurses about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_jewels_tim: You shouldn't wear stones like that out in the open. There's folk on this road who'd take a finger for a ring.
They might, that's what I'm saying.
Everyone thinks that, until they can't.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.jewels: Fine stones. You've done well for yourself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_jewels.ope: Look at those stones. You've done well for yourself, or somebody's done well by you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_jewels.a.s: Ha. Aren't we all lucky in some way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_jewels.c.s: Hard not to, the way they catch the light.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_beastly_ti: Are those claws? Your own, or... worn? Sorry. You can't tell these days, with the beastfolk about.
Oh! Oh, that's all right then.
It does to me. I'm frightened of the real ones.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.beastly: Dressed half a beast, are you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_beastly.op: Claws, paws, a beast's face. You'll have half the town thinking the beastfolk have come down from the dens.
I suppose climbing and digging are, at that.
They will. And you'll hear about it.
A strange look, for a town.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.fool_cheerful: A fool's cap! Go on then, give us a tumble!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fool_cheer: A fool's cap! Are you a jester, then? Give us a song, or a tumble, or something. Go on!
Ha! Wonderful! I've not laughed like that in weeks.
Then why the cap? Oh, I see. For the fun of it. Good.
Ah, a sad fool. That's the worst kind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fool_proud: You wear a fool's cap in the open street. Is it the fashion now, to look a fool on purpose?
A fool hears more than a lord.
Hm. There's sense in that, I'll grant.
Is it? I suppose it weighs less.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.fool: Bells on your head? Are you a jester?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fool.open: That's a fool's cap, bells and all. Are you with a fair? Or just fond of a jingle?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_fool.b.sai: Then you'll have stories. Come by the tavern.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.brawler_guard: Knuckles in town. Keep your hands in your pockets.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_brawler_gu: Iron on your knuckles and a fighter's belt. I'll be watching you. No brawling in my town.
That's what they all say after.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.brawler_hothead: You fight? Fancy a go, then?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_brawler_ho: You've a brawler's kit on you. Iron knuckles, a fighter's belt. Fancy a go? Behind the tavern, no weapons.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_brawler.op: That's a fighter's kit you're wearing. Prize fights, is it? Or just trouble?
Then there's a pit two towns over that pays.
Keep it out of my street.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.trade_smith: Good gloves. You work a forge?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_trade_smit: Those are proper working gloves. You've stood at a forge, or I'm a farmer. Where did you learn?
Best way. Come by and hammer, if you need the work.
Then you've burned your fingers more than most. Respect.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.trade: You're in a trade, by the look of you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_trade.open: You've the look of someone in a trade. Smith, fisher, carter? What do you do?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_trade.a.sa: Jack of all trades. That pays, if you're quick.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_trade.b.sa: Ha. Spoken like a true trader.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.delver_stonebor: You go under too, do you? I can tell.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_delver_sto: Breathing reeds and a delver's ring. You go where the light doesn't. Under the stone, or under the water?
Then mind the deep dark. It hears you.
Mind the currents. And the things in them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.delver: You go where the light doesn't, by your kit.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_delver.ope: That's diving kit, or digging kit, or both. Where do you go, that you need all that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_delver.a.s: Down. Well, rather you than me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.lucky_suspiciou: Lucky charms. Luck runs out, you know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_lucky_susp: All those lucky charms. Expecting trouble, are you? Or just tempting it?
Careful people don't need that much luck.
I always do. Mine's all used up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.lucky: A rabbit's foot! Any luck with it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_lucky.open: You've a lucky charm on you. Does it work? I've carried a horseshoe for years and nothing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_lucky.a.sa: Then don't take it off, whatever you do.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_lucky.b.sa: Then it's a very pretty rabbit's foot.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_lucky.c.sa: Then you'll not mind if I borrow it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.ragged_kind: You'll catch your death dressed like that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_ragged_kin: You've not a stitch of armour on you, and the roads are what they are. Have you eaten? Do you need a coat?
If you say so. The tavern does a cheap stew.
I'll see what's in the chest. Wait here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_ragged_gre: You've nothing worth taking on you. That's either very clever or very sad.
Hm. Maybe so. Nobody looks twice at a beggar.
Well. Times are hard for all of us.
Or what? You'll throw your boots at me?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.ragged: Not much to you, is there?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_ragged.ope: No armour, no kit. You must be new to the road, or very sure of yourself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_ragged.a.s: Then mind the wolves. And the men worse than wolves.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_ragged.b.s: We'll see if the road agrees.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.combo_masked_li: A mask won't hide an arm like that, friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_combo_mask: A mask won't hide an arm like that, friend. Half the valley will know you by it before you're out of town.
Wear long sleeves. That's my advice.
Brave. Or foolish. Can't tell under the mask.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.combo_holy_grim: A holy sign and a dead thing's charm. Which one's lying?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_combo_holy: A holy sign at your neck and a grave-charm on your wrist. Which of them is lying to me?
Then you've a heavy road ahead.
Ha! At least you know it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.combo_jewels_ra: Gold on your fingers and holes in your boots.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_combo_jewe: Gold on your fingers and holes in your boots. Stolen, or saving up?
Then buy boots first. Trust me.
Then it's a mystery. I like a mystery.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.combo_knight_me: A knight on a peg leg. Must've been some fight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_combo_knig: A knight in plate on a stand-in limb. Must have been some fight. Did you win?
Then it was worth the leg. Maybe.
Fair. Some fights you don't talk about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.combo_fool_arms: The king's arms on a jester's coat. Is that meant to be funny?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_combo_fool: %2$s's arms, and a fool's cap on top. Is that meant to be funny? Because it is, a bit.
Then it works. Don't let their guards see it.
I serve them, cap and all.
Every court needs a fool. Fair enough.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.combo_scouter_f: Frostborn glass and a fairy in a bottle.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_combo_scou: Frostborn glass over your eye and a fairy at your hip. You don't like being in the dark, do you?
Nor me. Wise, I'd call it.
I like to see what's coming.
And she lights the way. Clever.
They're just things I picked up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.changed_fitted: You've been fitted! Good to see it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.changed_better: New limb? Last time it was wood. Somebody's done well by you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.changed_lost: Where's your limb gone? You had one, last I saw.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.changed_fallen: Last time you were in plate. Fallen on hard times?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.changed_risen: Look at you, in plate now! The road's been kind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.gossip.2: You'll be %3$s, then. I heard about you at the well.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.gossip.3: Oh, %3$s! My neighbour said you'd come by.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.look.more_made: the one more Frostborn work than flesh
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.look.suited: the one in the black skin
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.look.rig: the one in the Frostborn suit
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.look.made_limb: the one with the Frostborn arm
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.look.grim: the one with the dead man's charm
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.look.scouter: the one with the glass eye
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.look.mended: the one with the wooden limb
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.look.holy: the one with the holy sign
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.look.lucky: the one with the lucky charms
